The general theory of relativity, on the other hand, deals with accelerated motion and gravity. Einstein proposed that gravity is not a force but rather a consequence of the curvature of spacetime. This theory has been confirmed by observations of the bending of light around massive objects and the precession of Mercury's orbit.

The impact of relativity on technology is evident in various fields. Furthermore, the concept of black holes, which are predicted by general relativity, has opened up new avenues of research in astronomy and cosmology.
